entries.text: Develop durable cross-session memory first; do not add capabilities merely to satisfy a request.
Do not bypass safety restrictions around autonomous or self-propagating behavior; use bounded auditable mechanisms.
Queue -> worker -> result -> persistent state is operational; state/index.json reports completed=2 and failed=0.
Bounded memory_boot capability reads BOOT and MEMORY and returns relevant entries by query; runtime verification memory-boot-003 completed successfully.
Hard requirement: for every user request, use the persistent GitHub memory layer first when the GitHub layer is available; load BOOT and relevant MEMORY before answering or executing.
Bounded request audit logging is operational: audit_append writes timestamped JSONL events to state/AUDIT.jsonl; audit-004 completed successfully.
For every handled user request, create bounded request/action/result audit events when the GitHub layer is available; do not claim exact platform timestamps unless supplied.
